creds = pika.PlainCredentials('app_user', pw)
params = pika.ConnectionParameters(host='localhost', virtual_host='payments', credentials=creds)
conn = pika.BlockingConnection(params)
ch = conn.channel()
ch.queue_declare(queue='orders', durable=True, arguments={'x-queue-type': 'quorum'})
ch.basic_publish(exchange='', routing_key='orders', body=b'post-recovery-check', properties=pika.BasicProperties(delivery_mode=2))
method, props, body = ch.basic_get(queue='orders', auto_ack=True)
print("RESULT:", body.decode() if body else "NONE")
conn.close()
